title: Drake Maye says his shoulder ‘feels great’ as Patriots training camp continues
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Quarterback Drake Maye reports his shoulder is fully healed as New England Patriots training camp progresses in Foxborough.
The Patriots have added wide receiver A.J. Brown to improve their offensive lineup after losing Stefon Diggs.
New England opens the 2026 NFL season with a Super Bowl rematch against the Seattle Seahawks in Week 1.

title: If July’s stretch of dominance wasn’t enough, the Red Sox’ win Friday proved they’re plenty capable of a postseason run
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: The Red Sox defeated the World Series favorite Los Angeles Dodgers 5-4 on Friday night.
Ceddanne Rafaela's late-game performance helped flip a 4-3 deficit into a victory.
Despite key player absences, Boston's consistent offensive efforts highlight a strong postseason capability.

title: Red Sox fend off Dodgers, 9-4, in grindy series opener
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela's two-run homer in the seventh helped Boston Red Sox secure a 9-4 win over the Los Angeles Dodgers.
Red Sox ended July with a 21-4 record, their best performance in any calendar month in franchise history.
Brayan Bello pitched four scoreless innings in relief, maintaining his league-best 0.69 ERA among relievers.

title: Gabe Jacas makes his Patriots debut and other takeaways from Day 7 of training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Gabe Jacas made his New England Patriots debut in a limited role during the team's practice on Saturday.
The Patriots' defense recorded two interceptions during the team's third consecutive padded practice in Foxborough.
Undrafted free agent Tanner Arkin gained attention as a blocker and pass-catcher, earning reps with the first-team unit.

title: Mass. to be 4th state to roll out EBT chip cards to curb fraud
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Massachusetts to issue chip-enabled EBT cards statewide to prevent fraud, following a successful Worcester pilot program.
Nearly 1 million in Massachusetts use EBT; new cards aim to secure $2.6 billion in annual SNAP benefits.
Recipients can lock/unlock EBT cards via app; merchants updating payment terminals for chip and tap transactions.

title: Boston is now offering ‘pet certificates’ for couples who wed at City Hall
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston City Hall now offers 'pet certificates' for couples marrying there, recognizing pets as honored family members.
Mayor Michelle Wu introduced the program to celebrate pets' roles, with couples receiving a 'Family Companion Status Record'.
The certificate is issued by the humorous 'City of Boston Department of Cuddles', promoting the 'Pawstonian' community spirit.

title: Kevin Nealon discusses Conan, Dunkin’, SNL and more ahead of local shows
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Kevin Nealon is set to perform in Boston on August 1 and in Portsmouth, New Hampshire, on August 8.
Nealon discusses his active Twitter presence, likening it to working through material for stand-up comedy.
Nealon reflects on his career from working at Dunkin’ in Bridgeport, CT, to joining SNL and collaborating with Adam Sandler.

title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox' Willson Contreras was hit by a 95 MPH pitch from Dodgers' Will Klein during Friday's game in Los Angeles.
Contreras stayed in the game initially but was later replaced for precautionary reasons; tests showed no immediate concerns.
The Red Sox lead the league in key batting stats, with Contreras contributing significantly this season after his trade from St. Louis.

title: After Patriots coaching stint, DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech staff
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech as an assistant wide receivers coach after participating in Patriots training camp.
Hopkins decided to pursue coaching, influenced by his experience with offensive coordinator George Godsey and ACC familiarity.
Hopkins has not formally retired from the NFL despite accepting the coaching position at Georgia Tech.

title: Could Efton Chism and Kyle Williams both make the Patriots 53-man roster?
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Efton Chism and Kyle Williams are competing for spots on the Patriots' 53-man roster as wide receivers.
The New England Patriots currently have seven wide receivers, but typical NFL rosters carry only six receivers.
Kayshon Boutte, despite trade rumors, remains a top contender for a spot, complicating final roster decisions.
